zsh: fix git co completion substring match and special chars

- __git_co_branch_names: filter branches by PREFIX substring so 'mmh' matches *mmh*
- Use compadd -M 'r:|?=**' so completions are shown (not hidden by prefix-only match)
- Set matcher-list for git-co context so substring matching applies
- Avoid __git_branch_names/__git_describe_commit so branch names with # or : don't break compadd

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

zsh: implement git co (worktree-aware checkout) and fast completion

- git_wrapper.zsh: re-enable git() wrapper; intercept 'git co' and call _git_co_impl
- functions.zsh: add _git_co_impl with:
  - git co <branch>: cd to worktree if branch has one, else git checkout
  - git co -b <branch>: git checkout -b
  - git co -w -b <branch>: new worktree + branch, then cd there
  - git co -: jump to last branch/worktree (saved in .git/last-co)
- git_completion.zsh: add _git-co (hyphen) for compsys; fast local-branch
  completion only (no remote/tree-ish to avoid 9s hang)
- test-git-co-completion: add tests for completion wiring and _git_co_impl

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix: Bluetooth/Pipewire installation with better error handling

- Handle pipewire-jack version conflicts gracefully

fix: improve Zsh verification to be more tolerant

- More informative error messages
